name: keel-design-system
description: The Aperture Risk token files, as both apps consume them: fonts, colours, typography, spacing, radii.
//: A package for the same reason keel-engine is one (ADR-49): chartroom-studio consumes these across a workspace boundary. It reached them at '../../../src/styles/aperture/tokens/*.css', which is the provenance claim this stylesheet's own header warns about — a copy-by-path that nothing enforces. Only the token files and the sheet are exported; there is no bare entry point, because there is no single stylesheet that means 'the design system'.
